cues: A curved wire stand keeps the soft produce suspended above the counter, away from bruising pressure from heavier groceries.
A cook places an unripe avocado in a paper sack with a ripe piece to help it soften by morning.
Fruit flies gather around an overripe piece forgotten on the kitchen counter during a warm summer evening.
After dental work, someone chooses a soft, mild snack instead of crackers or crunchy raw vegetables.
At a hotel buffet, a guest takes a whole piece along for the commute without needing a plate or utensils.
A caregiver mashes a ripe piece into plain yogurt when a child needs a simple snack between meals.
